name: Unelma Email Verification with SnapValid
author: unelmaplatforms

sections.description:
Unelma Email Verification with SnapValid helps prevent fake signups, disposable emails, and invalid email addresses by validating emails in real time using the SnapValid API.

Improve data quality, reduce spam, and protect your website from low-quality leads.

Features

  • Real-time email validation
  • WooCommerce checkout validation
  • WordPress registration validation
  • Contact Form 7 integration
  • Disposable email detection
  • Bulk email verification tool
  • Credit usage dashboard inside WordPress

Supported Integrations

  • WooCommerce
  • Contact Form 7
  • WordPress core registration

External Services

This plugin connects to the SnapValid API to verify email addresses in real time.

When a user submits a form, the email address is securely sent to the SnapValid API for validation.

Service URL: https://snapvalid.com
Privacy Policy: https://snapvalid.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to SnapValid in the admin menu
  4. Enter your API key
sections.faq:
Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes.

Does this work with Contact Form 7?

Yes.

Does this send emails from my server?

No. The plugin only validates email addresses using the SnapValid API.
